name: Vidcruiter
summary: Vidcruiter is a recruiting platform with one-way and live video interviews, candidate self-booking from synced calendars, and structured scorecards for hiring managers. Its pricing page names no plans or prices and asks visitors to fill in a form.

facts.text: The homepage says candidates answer structured questions on their own schedule, and that live video sessions include built-in rating guides.
The homepage says candidates book, reschedule and cancel interviews from synced interviewer calendars.
The homepage says hiring managers review, score and collaborate on candidates, and that they get structured scorecards with adjustable rating scales.
The homepage says automated scoring evaluates every response against role-specific rubrics.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: The pricing page says visitors fill in a form to get pricing. No plan names or prices are shown.

hiddenCosts: No plan names, prices or minimums are published in the text read from the pricing page.
